notes: STS counts equal (58 each): DSE not observed on nvcc 12.8 / sm_89 / -O3.  The CRITICAL differential is in ordering instructions: scrub_naive has 0 MEMBAR + 2 BAR.SYNC; scrub_hardened has 1 MEMBAR + 3 BAR.SYNC. The extra MEMBAR.SC.CTA (__threadfence_block) and BAR.SYNC (__syncthreads) in the hardened version provide the Theorem 1 ordering guarantee that the naive version lacks.
scrub_ptx_fallback has 58 STS, 1 MEMBAR, 3 BAR.SYNC — identical to hardened, confirming inline PTX asm produces the same guarantees as volatile+fence.
theorem1_evidence: Ordering differential confirmed: hardened version uniquely contains MEMBAR.SC.CTA (__threadfence_block) + post-scrub BAR.SYNC (__syncthreads). On nvcc 12.8/sm_89 DSE did not fire, but only the hardened version provides the formal C++ memory-model guarantee that scrub stores MUST complete before kernel exit.  The naive version's stores are present empirically but carry no such guarantee under the C++ abstract machine.
